summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of the new Forgot-Password flow (regression) and Live Screen-Capture feature for Casino Spotter. 18/18 backend pytest cases pass in /app/backend/tests/test_forgot_live.py. Frontend Playwright: all 5 forgot/reset UI checks pass; admin/premium /live page renders with cost-notice, no trial-banner, enabled START button; free-user /live shows 60-second trial banner + GO PREMIUM upsell and enabled start; after flipping live_trial_used=true on the free user, banner switches to 'trial has been used' and start button is disabled with label 'TRIAL USED — UPGRADE TO RESUME'. Navbar LIVE link and Dashboard 'Live capture' quick tile (NEW badge) present. /analyze and /legitimacy regression pages load. Admin password restored to CasForensics2026! and admin user state restored (is_premium=true, live_trial_used=false).

minor.issue: Pydantic EmailStr will 422 on malformed emails (good), but the endpoint never returns 422 for valid-format unknown emails (intentional — anti-enumeration). Worth noting in API docs.

If Gemini call fails (e.g. budget cap), the endpoint still returns 200 with note='frame skipped: ...' instead of surfacing 502. This is fault-tolerant by design, but the technique slug list will silently be empty and the user has no UX signal that the frame failed.

The frame image is written to disk under UPLOAD_DIR before being analyzed; on a high-volume premium user the 12-frame-per-3min stream is small, but in production this should be in-memory only — no need to touch disk.

Sets live_trial_used=true on session START (not on first successful frame), so a free user who opens /live and clicks start but cancels the OS share dialog burns their only trial. Consider moving the flag flip to first /live/frame success.

Idempotency works via early-return when ended_at exists, but the response is built from the persisted session doc; if frames were appended between two end calls (race), the 2nd call would echo stale summary. Low priority — UI calls end exactly once.

issues: Trial banner text 'Your free 60-second live trial has been used.' wraps awkwardly next to the GO PREMIUM button on narrow viewports — fine at 1920px; verify mobile.

action_items: LOW: Move live_trial_used=true flip from /live/session/start to first successful /live/frame so a cancelled OS-share dialog doesn't burn the user's only trial.
LOW: Surface a non-200 (502) or a structured 'error' field on /live/frame when Gemini fails so the UI can show 'analysis unavailable' instead of an empty/skipped note.
LOW: Skip writing the frame jpeg to disk in /live/frame — pass bytes directly to FileContentWithMimeType (or via tmpfile that lives in /tmp). UPLOAD_DIR write+unlink on every 15s is unnecessary IO.
INFO: Document anti-enumeration behaviour of /auth/forgot-password in the public API docs.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~1928 lines — well past the 700-line threshold. Strongly recommend splitting into routers: auth.py, live.py, stripe.py, seo.py, affiliates.py.

live_trial_used is flipped inside live_session_start BEFORE the user has actually captured anything. If they cancel the browser's getDisplayMedia prompt, their only trial is consumed with zero value delivered. Move the flag to first successful frame.
Frame analysis writes a temp jpeg to UPLOAD_DIR every 15s. Should use in-memory bytes; UPLOAD_DIR is a shared disk path.

Race-safety: end_session uses early-return on ended_at, but the response rebuild reads frames AFTER the idempotency check. If a stale call arrives after another frame is appended (shouldn't happen via UI but possible from a buggy client), 2nd call returns stale summary + newer frame_count. Acceptable for MVP.
/live/sessions list endpoint correctly suppresses frames in the response — good.
Pydantic EmailStr validation on ForgotPasswordReq works. Generic response for unknown emails (anti-enumeration) is correctly implemented.

rca of the issue: No critical issues. One UX risk to flag: live_trial_used flag is set on /live/session/start before the user has done anything useful, so cancelling the OS share dialog burns the trial. Reproduction: signup fresh user, POST /api/live/session/start (sets live_trial_used=true server-side regardless of whether any frames are ever submitted), now POST start again → 402. Fix: move the $set:{live_trial_used:true} from live_session_start (server.py ~line 772) into live_frame after the first successful frame, OR roll it back inside live_session_end if frame_count==0.
